gap: No result ChatGPT got works out that, in continuous amps, Redodo's $836.99 battery (5,000 W max on its own store page, about 98 A at 51.2 V) and LiTime's $899.99 battery (1C = 100 A continuous, 600 A for 1 s) both fall below the 200 A continuous that ChatGPT itself set as the minimum, while its budget answer called the Redodo a '200A BMS'. LiTime's '200A' pack at $1,097.99 holds that current for only 2 minutes ('2C discharge rate @ 2 minutes').
standout_why: I compared golfcartgearlab.com/best/best-lithium-golf-cart-battery (Vatrer, Weize, Interstate, Trojan, Dakota) and golfcartshowdown.com (Bolt, Eco, Dakota, Allied). Neither covers LiTime, Redodo or NewtiPower, and neither puts peak duration or cycle end-of-life on a common basis. The cited LiTime page states 1C and 600 A (1 s) but never converts that into amps or compares it with other brands. gearranking.com would not load (certificate error). Our own dealectric page already lists LiTime at 600 A × 1 s, the LiTime 200 A model as '2C @ 2 minutes' and Redodo at about 98 A from 5,000 W. So the new part is putting these next to ChatGPT's own 200 A rule and its three budget picks, plus NewtiPower's kit and price split.
decides: This partly changes the pick. On amps their makers state, none of ChatGPT's three budget picks can be confirmed to meet its own '200A continuous' rule. Redodo's own page gives 5,000 W, which is about 98 A, not 200 A. LiTime's is 100 A. NewtiPower's 200 A appears only in Amazon listing titles, with no peak duration given. For a stock cart, the Redodo at $836.99 and the LiTime at $899.99 are the same class (about 100 A, 5.12 kWh). For lifted carts or carts with upgraded controllers, the cheapest pack whose maker states 200 A is the LiTime at $1,097.99, and LiTime states that as a 2-minute rating. A 200 A continuous rating that holds without a time limit (Vatrer, already on our page) costs about $1,580. NewtiPower's $789.99 listing is not the kit with a charger. The kits with a charger are $779.99 (plastic case) and $829.99 (steel case).
